name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures an Nginx web server with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, static content, redirects, security headers, rate limiting, compression, per-site logs, and host security controls.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis on port 6379 with password authentication, and manages Redis logging storage and configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python tooling, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user configuration, application environment settings, and a Uvicorn systemd service.
